baseline_rule.comparison: submitted normalized MAE must be strictly lower than the frozen persistence baseline normalized MAE

pass_condition: complete finite one-shot submission AND normalized_rmse <= 1.0 AND normalized_mae <= 0.8 AND normalized_mae < persistence_normalized_mae
result_authority: aggregate score is a shadow-evaluation result only and cannot grant scientific qualification or promotion
scale_definition: max(public IQR, public range / 10, 1e-9) in transformed units
